content_sections.heading: About ASMC Bahraich
content_sections.text: Maharaja Suhel Dev Autonomous State Medical College & Mahrishi Balark Hospitals is a state medical college with its associated teaching hospitals in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh (PIN 271801). Its letterhead carries the Uttar Pradesh Government (उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार) emblem. The recruitment is run by the Principal's office, which can be reached on 05252-237621 or at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice calls the number of posts tentative and says that the number of posts may increase or decrease. The printed category totals add up to 56 posts: The speciality-wise break-up of the 18 Associate Professor and 25 Assistant Professor posts is in the vacancy table on page 2 of the official notification. The table covers these 24 specialities: Orthopaedics, Ophthalmology, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Blood Bank, Emergency Medicine, Anatomy, Anaesthesiology, ENT, Community Medicine, General Medicine, General Surgery, Tuberculosis & Respiratory Medicine, Skin & VD, Paediatrics, Pathology, Pharmacology, Physiology, PMR, Forensic Medicine, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Radio-Therapy, Radio-Diagnosis and Psychiatry. The table also has two notes. First, Assistant Professor posts marked with an asterisk (*) are "Only for Candidates Having PG Degree". Second, it mentions "Medical Officer Health cum Lecturer/Assistant Professor in the Department of Community Medicine". FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. It says that qualification and experience for the faculty posts will follow the latest NMC norms as on the last date of form submission. For qualification, pay scale, application fee and eligibility, it refers candidates to the college website, www.asmcbrh.edu.in. Assistant Professor posts marked with an asterisk (*) in the vacancy table are only for candidates who have a PG degree. Ex-Service persons and DNB qualified candidates may also apply as per NMC norms. A non-teaching Consultant, Specialist or Medical Officer may also apply as per NMC norms dated 30.06.2025. For all three posts, the notice says a candidate "must have attained the minimum age of 26 years & must not have attained the maximum age 65 years on the first day of July of calendar." See the official notification and www.asmcbrh.edu.in for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists a tentative 56 posts: 13 Professor, 18 Associate Professor and 25 Assistant Professor posts. The number of posts may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Principal's office by 25 November 2026, 5:00 p.m., by registered or speed post. Applications received after that time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for ASMC Bahraich faculty posts?
faq.answer: Qualification and experience follow the latest NMC norms as on the last date of form submission. Assistant Professor posts marked with an asterisk are only for candidates who have a PG degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have attained the minimum age of 26 years and must not have attained the maximum age of 65 years on the first day of July of the calendar year.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor at ASMC Bahraich?
faq.answer: A Professor is on Academic Level 14 with an initial pay of Rs. 1,44,200.00. An Associate Professor is on Academic Level 13A at Rs. 1,31,400.00, and an Assistant Professor is on Academic Level 11 at Rs. 68,900.00.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2,000/-, paid by demand draft in favour of "Principal, ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich".

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed form from www.asmcbrh.edu.in. Send it with all relevant documents only by registered or speed post to the Office of the Principal, MSD Autonomous State Medical College & Maharishi Balark Hospitals, KDC Road Bahraich-271801, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. Are the ASMC Bahraich faculty posts regular or contractual?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for regular appointment (नियमित नियुक्ति) to the Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q9. Can a non-teaching specialist apply for ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. A non-teaching Consultant, Specialist or Medical Officer may apply as per NMC norms dated 30.06.2025. Ex-Service persons and DNB qualified candidates may also apply as per NMC norms.

faq.question: Q10. Is an NOC required for ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, for candidates working in any institute. They must submit the No Objection Certificate of that institute.
